hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *docs/PROGRESS.md) echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"docs/PROGRESS.md was modified: reconcile the checkboxes in docs/PLAN.md so the roadmap matches, ideally in the same commit (sync rule in docs/PLAN.md).\"}}";; esac

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) out=$(npx biome format --write "$f" 2>&1); case "$out" in *"Fixed "*) jq -n --arg ctx "Biome reformatted $f (PostToolUse hook, format-only, non-blocking)." '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$ctx}}';; esac ;; esac
